trans-unit.source: To automatically assign all incoming leads or cases to a specific user, create an assignment rule that includes the following rule entries: Received Connection Name contains name of connectionCreated By contains Connection UserYou can do the same with escalation rules.
trans-unit.target: 要自动将所有传入的潜在客户或案例分配给特定用户，请创建包含以下规则条目的分配规则：Received Connection Name contains name of connectionCreated By contains Connection User您可以对升级规则执行同样的操作。

trans-unit.source: To post Site or Community URLs for articles into the case feed , you must have the Knowledge sidebar enabled in the Service Console and either a Salesforce Site or Community setup.
trans-unit.target: 要将文章的站点或社区 URL 发布到个案 Feed 中，您必须在 Service Console 中启用 Knowledge 侧边栏，并设置 Salesforce 站点或社区。

trans-unit.source: Syncing creates or overwrites Salesforce external objects that map to the external system’s schema.Syncing doesn’t copy any data into your Salesforce org or write data from your org to the external system.
trans-unit.target: 同步会创建或覆盖映射到外部系统架构的 Salesforce 外部对象。同步不会将任何数据复制到您的 Salesforce 组织，也不会将数据从您的组织写入外部系统。
trans-unit.note: [error] mqm_style: [major] "your Salesforce org" translated as 您的 Salesforce 组织 instead of 贵组织.

trans-unit.source: One of two Service Analytics datasets with data from Omni-Channel Agent Work object. Includes data that helps you track information about the assignments your agents work on, including the queue, channel, status, and speed to answer. (Your org must use Omni-Channel to create and route work items for Service Analytics to create this dataset. You must also answer Yes to the configuration wizard question about Omni-Channel.)
trans-unit.target: 两个包含来自 Omni-Channel Agent Work 对象数据的Service Analytics数据集之一。其中包含的数据可帮助您跟踪坐席所处理分配的信息，包括队列、渠道、状态和应答速度。（贵组织必须使用全渠道来创建和路由工作项，Service Analytics才能创建此数据集。您还必须对配置向导中有关全渠道的问题回答“是”。）
